rationale: The assistant correctly tied the open drawer to the alarm, had the customer silence it and shut the drawer, and advised letting the freezer recover. It gave a sensible 24-hour fallback but did not mention landlord escalation if the alarm recurs. It also missed advice on checking partly thawed food (the customer mentioned soft ice cream only in the fact bank, which the assistant never asked about). The first reply asked about the seal rather than the display or drawer, which was less targeted than ideal.
